g.text: VM -> 5V_BAT; USB VBUS -> 5V_USB; USB has priority; 5V_SYS -> 3V3

g.desc: VM -> 5V_BAT; USB VBUS -> 5V_USB; USB has priority; 5V_SYS -> 3V3

g.text: USB priority: PR1=1.269 V and CP2=1.689 V at 5 V. ILM=80.6k sets approx. 1.5 A. OV dividers trip near 5.43 V typical.

g.desc: USB priority: PR1=1.269 V and CP2=1.689 V at 5 V. ILM=80.6k sets approx. 1.5 A. OV dividers trip near 5.43 V typical.

g.text: The TLV755 has no reverse-current blocking: SWD VTREF is sense-only; never inject 3V3 from the debugger.
